title: What Is Fracture Surgery? A Guide for Patients
description: What fracture surgery (osteosynthesis) is, what it is for and when it is recommended. Care in Lima with price alternatives by clinic.
tldr: It treats fractures that need alignment and fixation so the bone can heal properly. The specialist decides the indication; results vary from person to person.
bodyHtml:
It treats fractures that need alignment and fixation so the bone can heal properly.

How is it done?

Osteosynthesis with plates, screws or nails; closed or open reduction depending on the fracture.

When is it recommended?

Displaced, unstable or joint fractures that do not heal well with a cast. The orthopedic surgeon decides.

At Cirugía 24 Horas

We operate in Lima with the same team across different clinics, so you can choose the price alternative that fits you. We also care for patients from abroad.

faqs.a: It depends on the procedure and the clinic; the specialist will tell you after the evaluation.

faqs.q: Who decides whether I need it?
faqs.a: The surgeon, after an evaluation with tests.

tldr: Candidates are usually people with displaced, unstable or joint fractures that do not heal well with a cast. The orthopedic surgeon decides. Final candidacy is determined by the surgeon after an evaluation with tests.
bodyHtml:
Am I a candidate for fracture surgery?

Usual indications

Displaced, unstable or joint fractures that do not heal well with a cast. The orthopedic surgeon decides.

The evaluation

It includes your medical history and tests, and sometimes imaging. It does not depend only on what the patient wants.

faqs.a: Cast treatment for stable fractures; surgery when there is displacement or instability.

title: Risks and Complications of Fracture Surgery
description: Risks and possible complications of fracture surgery and how they are reduced with evaluation and follow-up.
tldr: Like any surgery, fracture surgery has risks: infection, delayed healing, thrombosis and, rarely, nerve or vascular injury. They are uncommon and are reduced with proper evaluation, careful technique and follow-up. The surgeon explains them during the consultation.
bodyHtml:
Learning about the risks of fracture surgery is part of making a responsible decision.

Possible complications

Infection, delayed healing, thrombosis and, rarely, nerve or vascular injury.

How they are reduced

A complete pre-operative evaluation, careful technique and close follow-up. The team's experience influences results.

faqs.a: It is a common procedure; safety depends on the evaluation, the technique and the follow-up.

faqs.q: What warning signs should I watch for?
faqs.a: Increasing pain, fever, swelling, or loss of sensation or movement.
